clips.title: The story
paras: Viktori Prism'Antras needs Blind Mary's looking glass for his telescope in Darkshire. An Insane Ghoul took it to Tranquil Gardens Cemetery in southern Duskwood.

Blind Mary once treasured an ornate looking glass. After an incident took her sight and sanity and left her a weeping spirit, she threw it into the dirt behind her family barn. Now the astronomer Viktori Prism'Antras needs the mirror for his telescope in Darkshire. The looking glass was taken long before he began studying the heavens.

An Insane Ghoul scavenged the looking glass from behind the ruined farmsteads. Restless hunger drove the undead creature south, carrying the mirror to Tranquil Gardens Cemetery. It haunts an abandoned chapel among the overgrown tombstones. You face the flesh-eating horrors of the southern woods to reclaim Mary's lost treasure from its rotting claws.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The looking glass was one of my finest treasures until... The incident. After that happened, I discarded it behind the barn. There was an Insane Ghoul who used to roam back there. Perhaps he picked it up. Rumor has it the devilish beast resides in the Tranquil Gardens Cemetery.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I showed Cog the beginnings of our star-viewing machine. He was impressed. Did you happen to find a reflective device?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Most superb! This will work perfectly. Many thanks!
